record.original_question: For which domains is the Bergman kernel function K(z,w) nonvanishing everywhere, as in the Lu Qi-Keng problem?

evidence.quote: Problem 7.2.2 For which domains is the Bergman kernal function K(z, w) nonvanishing everywhere? This is related to Lu Qi-Keng conjecture. 7.3 The Caratheodory Metric c

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be a bounded domain, and let $A^2(\Omega)$ denote the Hilbert space of holomorphic functions on $\Omega$ that are square-integrable with respect to Lebesgue measure. The Bergman kernel of $\Omega$ is the reproducing kernel $K_\Omega:\Omega\times\Omega\to\mathbb{C}$ of $A^2(\Omega)$, characterized by $f(z)=\int_\Omega K_\Omega(z,w)f(w)\,dV(w)$ for every $f\in A^2(\Omega)$ and $z\in\Omega$. Call $\Omega$ a Lu Qi-Keng domain if $K_\Omega(z,w)\neq 0$ for all $(z,w)\in\Omega\times\Omega$.

Give an intrinsic characterization of those bounded domains $\Omega\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ that are Lu Qi-Keng domains; equivalently, determine necessary and sufficient geometric or function-theoretic conditions on $\Omega$ under which the Bergman kernel $K_\Omega$ is everywhere nonvanishing on $\Omega\times\Omega$.
artifact.status_search_result: The original Lu Qi-Keng conjecture (that the Bergman kernel is nonvanishing for every bounded domain) was disproved by Skwarczyński (1969) using an annulus with small inner radius, and many further counterexamples are known (products of disc and annulus, fat Hartogs triangles, certain Thullen/Hua domains). Positive results hold for the ball, polydisc, and bounded homogeneous complete circular domains. The general problem of classifying which bounded domains are Lu Qi-Keng domains remains open.

status_evidence.title: Lu Qi-Keng's Problem (Boas survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing the failure of the original conjecture and the open problem of classifying domains whose Bergman kernel has zeros.
status_evidence.claim: Classifying Lu Qi-Keng domains is an open problem; original conjecture is false.

status_evidence.title: Lu Qi-Keng Problem and Topological Properties of Zero Variety on the Thullen Domain
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work investigating which Thullen domains are Lu Qi-Keng.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on identifying Lu Qi-Keng domains.

status_evidence.title: Arithmetic properties and zeros of the Bergman kernel on a class of quotient domains
status_evidence.snippet: 2025 work on zeros of Bergman kernels on quotient domains.
status_evidence.claim: Determination of Lu Qi-Keng property remains an active open problem.
